title: Industrial Strength High Performance RISC V Processors For Energy Efficient Computing
summary: David Ditzel of Esperanto Technologies presents their massively parallel, energy-efficient RISC-V processors at the 7th RISC-V Workshop in 2017. It covers the high-performance many-core design aimed at machine learning.
why: Cited in RISC-V and AI hardware threads as the source for Esperanto's ambitious many-core vector design.
